hints: Recall the powers of ten for the prefixes in the lists: kilo, deci, centi, milli and pico.
Write them as kilo $10^{3}$, deci $10^{-1}$, centi $10^{-2}$, milli $10^{-3}$ and pico $10^{-12}$ to compare sizes.
Test each list from left to right and keep only the list where the exponent gets smaller at every step.
walkthrough: List the prefix values needed: kilo means $10^{3}$, deci means $10^{-1}$, centi means $10^{-2}$, milli means $10^{-3}$ and pico means $10^{-12}$.
The question asks for strictly decreasing magnitude, so the powers of 10 must get smaller moving left to right.
Check A: $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-1}$ increases, so it fails at the first step.
Check B and C: B goes $10^{-1}$ to $10^{-3}$ then up to $10^{-2}$, and C goes $10^{-12}$ up to $10^{3}$, so both fail.
Check kilo, milli, pico: $10^{3}$ to $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-12}$ gets smaller at each step. This is option D.

options.A: Centi is $10^{-2}$ and deci is $10^{-1}$, so centi to deci is an increase, not a decrease.
options.B: Deci $10^{-1}$ to milli $10^{-3}$ decreases, but milli $10^{-3}$ to centi $10^{-2}$ increases again.
options.C: Pico is $10^{-12}$ and kilo is $10^{3}$, so pico to kilo is a large increase, not a decrease.
options.D: Kilo $10^{3}$ to milli $10^{-3}$ to pico $10^{-12}$ decreases at each step from left to right.
